description:
I also do think that AI engineering will be the most in demand tech job in 2027. 

I don’t think that’s software engineers are going anywhere either, but I do think that the demand for AI engineering will pick up quite heavily in 2027. 

Specifically, if you want to work on systems that are leveraging AI at their core, then I highly recommend AI engineering. You get to work on building out software and understanding the latest innovations in the industry. 

You don’t necessarily need a software engineering background to get into AI engineering, but it does help a lot and makes it easier since a lot of the principles overlap. 

if you want a roadmap of going from SWE —> ai engineer 
follow me & comment “roadmap” and I’ll send it over to you.
